facts.fact: CIVICUS Monitor reports that civil society leader Aliou Badra Sacko's Front Touche pas a mon argent was meeting to counter the newly introduced mobile money and telecommunications taxes when he was abducted.
facts.system: Front Touche pas a mon argent

facts.fact: CIVICUS Monitor reports opposition leader Mamadou Traore was arrested by law enforcement after the Cybercrime Unit alleged false information over an online interview criticising the junta-appointed council.
CIVICUS Monitor reports the Cybercrime Court sentenced Imam Sekou Sidibe to two years in prison and a 1.5 million FCFA fine over a viral sermon criticising army leadership.
CIVICUS Monitor reports the High Authority for Communication suspended and withdrew TV5-Monde from distributors' packages for its coverage of the suspension of political parties.
